fields.title: Okukula mu Magezi
fields.subtitle: Obulagirizi bw'Ekikristaayo ku Kuyiga, Obulamu, n'Obuwanguzi
fields.description: Obulagirizi bw'Ekikristaayo ku kuyiga, obulamu, n'obuwanguzi, obwawandiikirwa abayizi n'abavubuka. Essuula zaakyo ennyimpi — awamu n'empisa z'obulamu ekkumi n'ebbiri n'Ebyawandiikibwa ekkumi eby'omugaso eby'okujjukira — bikuyamba okukula mu magezi, mu mpisa, ne mu kukkiriza: okuvumbula ekigendererwa kyo, okuyiga obulungi, okuziyiza okukemebwa, okukwata ku ssente n'enneewulira, n'okuzimba ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebissa Katonda ekitiibwa.
fields.about_html:
Okukula mu Magezi kye kitabo kya Ochorus eky'okusooka, ekyawandiikibwa James DeGreef ku lw'abayizi n'abavubuka abaakatandika olugendo lw'obulamu. Okwawukana ku bitabo ebisinga obungi ebiri mu tterekero, si kya dda ekya bantu bonna okwetaba, wabula bulagirizi bwa mu biro bino, obugabibwa ku bwereere eri abasomi mu buli kifo.

Essuula zaakyo zitandika okuva ku kuvumbula ekigendererwa kyo okutuuka ku kuzimba okwolekera ebiseera eby'omu maaso, nga buli emu egatta amagezi ag'obukugu — engeri y'okuyigamu, engeri y'okuwangulamu obugayaavu, engeri y'okukwatamu obulemu, engeri y'okuddukanya ebiseera n'essente — n'Ekyawandiikibwa, okulowooza kw'okumala akaseera nga okwekkaanyizza, n'okusaba okusaako. Ebitundu ebirala bibiri, Empisa z'Obulamu Ekkumi n'Ebbiri n'Ebyawandiikibwa Ekkumi eby'Omugaso eri Abayizi, bikuŋŋaanya empisa n'ennyiriri ez'okutwala mu maaso n'okujjukira.

Ekyawandiikibwa nga kissa essira ku bayizi ab'omu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika, ebyokulabirako byakyo bituuka okuva ku Yusufu ne Dawudi okutuuka ku Ben Carson n'omuddusi Omunnayuganda Stephen Kiprotich, era eddoboozi mu kitabo kyonna lya kisa, lya butereevu, era lisibuka mu nzikiriza nti tewali muto nnyo oba mutono nnyo atasobola kubeera mu bulamu bwa magezi ku lwa Katonda. Ebiwandiiko by'Ebyawandiikibwa biva mu Baibuli Entukuvu, New International Version® (NIV®).

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Enteekateeka ya Katonda ku Ggwe
fields.body_html:
Wazaalibwa ku nsonga. Katonda teyakola nsobi bwe yakuteeka mu Uganda, mu maka go, mu ssomero lyo, era mu kiseera kino eky'enjawulo mu byafaayo. Oyinza obutaba nga otegedde buli kimu: ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso, omulimu gw'onookola, n'ebiruubirirwa byo. Naye waliwo ekintu kimu ky'oyinza okumanya awatali kubuusabuusa. Katonda akwagala nnyo, ayagala okubeera naawe mu nkolagana, era alina enteekateeka ennungi ku bulamu bwo.

"Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gy'oli," bw'ayogera Mukama, "enteekateeka ez'okukukulaakulanya so si okukukolako akabi, enteekateeka ez'okukuwa essuubi era n'obulamu obw'omu maaso." — Yeremiya 29:11

Buli lugendo olukulu lutandika n'ekigere kimu. Emyaka gy'olimu kaakano giri mu bigere ebisinga obukulu mu bulamu bwo. Empisa, endowooza, n'okukkiriza by'oteekawo kaakano bye birikola omuntu gw'olifuuka mu maaso. Oyimiridde ku mulyango gw'omukisa, era okusalawo kw'okola buli lunaku kwe kuligamba oba onootambulira mu magezi oba mu busirusiru, mu maanyi oba mu kwejjusa.

Ekitabo kino kyawandiikibwa kukuyamba kulonda magezi: kukuyamba okukula si mu by'okusoma byokka, naye mu bulamu bwo bwonna, nga mw'otwalidde okukkiriza kwo, emikwano gyo, enneewulira zo, obukulembeze bwo, n'ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso. Kigenderera okukuyigiriza engeri y'osomamu obulungi, n'obeeramu mu magezi, era n'ogoberera Katonda n'obwesigwa.

Amagezi si kwo kuba mukalabakalaba oba okuyisa ebibuuzo byokka. Buba busobozi bw'okusalawo obulungi, ne bwe wataba muntu akulaba. Kwe kubeerawo mu ngeri ewa Katonda ekitiibwa. Oyinza okuba omuyizi asinga mu ssomero lyo, ate n'osalawo obutali bwa magezi mu bulamu. Naye bw'oba n'amagezi, ojja kuwangula mu ebyo ebisinga obukulu.

"Kubanga Mukama awa amagezi; era mu kamwa ke muvaamu okumanya n'okutegeera." — Engero 2:6

Ekitabo kino kirimu essuula kkumi na ttaano, buli emu ng'ekuyigiriza amasomo ag'omu bulamu obwa buli lunaku n'ag'omwoyo. Ojja kuyiga engeri y'osomamu obulungi, engeri y'okozesaamu obudde bwo, engeri y'oziyizaamu okukemebwa, engeri y'okwaŋŋanga ku kweraliikirira, engeri y'okulemberamu abalala, n'engeri y'eteekerateekeramu ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso. Era ojja kuyiga ku bantu ab'amazima mu byafaayo ne mu Afirika abaabeerawo mu magezi ne batuukiriza ebintu ebikulu olw'okukkiriza n'okwefuga.

Bw'oba osoma, saba nga tonnaba kusoma buli ssuula. Saba Katonda akuyigirize. Kkiriza Ekigambo kye kyogere ku mutima gwo. Tosomanga na maaso go gokka. Somanga n'omwoyo gwo. Ku nkomerero ya buli ssuula, ojja kusangayo ebyawandiikibwa ebikulu n'okusaba. Bikozese okusemberera Katonda n'okunyweza obwongo bwo n'omutima gwo.

Toli muto nnyo okuleeta enkyukakyuka. Toli mutono nnyo okwaka omusana gwa Kristo. Walondebwa ku nsonga.

"Waleme kubaawo muntu n'omu akunyooma olw'obuvubuka bwo, naye mu kwogera ne mu bikolwa, ne mu kwagala, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu bulongoofu beera kyakulabirako eri abakkiriza." — 1 Timoseewo 4:12

Ka tutandike olugendo luno ffenna wamu ne Katonda, nga tugenda eri amagezi, amaanyi, n'obuwanguzi.

fields.title: Okuzuula Ekigendererwa Kyo
fields.body_html:
"Bwe nnali sinnakubumba mu lubuto lwa maama wo, nakumanya; nga tonnava mu lubuto, nakutukuza." — Yeremiya 1:5

Wakolebwa ku Nsonga

Buli muyizi ku kiseera ekimu yeebuuza nti: "Lwaki ndi wano? Ekigendererwa kyange kiruwa?" Kino kimu ku bibuuzo ebisinga obukulu by'oyinza okwebuuza. Bw'omanya ensonga lwaki obaawo, obulamu buba obulungi era obw'amakulu.

Watondebwa Katonda, si lwa mukisa gugwo, si lwa kabbo, so si lwa kusobya. Yakukola ng'alina ekigendererwa n'ekiruubirirwa. Yategeka obwongo bwo, ebirabo byo, n'omutima gwo ku kintu ekyenjawulo. Oyinza obutamanya kigendererwa ekyo kye kiri kaakano, era tekiri kabi. Ekigendererwa tekizuulwa mu kaseera kamu. Kyeyoleka nga bw'otambula ne Katonda, n'omugondera, n'okulira mu mpisa.

Lowooza ku nsigo. Mu nsigo entono mulimu obusobozi bw'omuti omunene. Naye ensigo esooka kusimbibwa, n'efukirirwa amazzi, n'eweebwa ekiseera. Mu ngeri y'emu, ekigendererwa kyo Katonda akisimba mu mutima gwo. Bw'oyiga, n'osaba, n'oweereza, ekigendererwa ekyo kitandika okukula.

Yusufu: Okuva ku Muloosi Okutuuka ku Mukulembeze

Mu Bayibuli, Yusufu yali muvubuka nga alina ebirooto ebinene. Baganda be baamukyawa, ne bamutunda ng'omuddu, era oluvannyuma n'asibwa mu kkomera. Naye Yusufu teyeerabira nti Katonda yali wamu naye. Mu buli kizibu, yasigala mwesigwa, era mu kiseera ekituufu, Katonda n'amuyimusa okuba omukulembeze mu Misiri, n'awonya obulamu bw'abantu bangi okuva mu njala.

Olugero lwa Yusufu lutulaga nti ekigendererwa tekibeera kyangu bulijjo. Oluusi Katonda akkiriza ebizibu bikole omutima gwo era bikuteekereteekere ebiseera eby'omu maaso. Singa Yusufu teyaba muddu, teyandiyize bukulembeze. Singa teyabeera mu kkomera, teyandisisinkanye omuntu eyaggulawo oluggi olw'ebyamutegekerwa.

"Mwagenderera okunnumya, naye Katonda n'akifuula ekirungi, n'akikozesa abantu baleme okufa." — Olubereberye 50:20

Ka embeera zo zibe zonna, oba ova mu maka amaavu, mu kyalo ekitono, oba osanga ebizibu mu ssomero, jjukira nti Katonda ayinza okubikozesa byonna okuleeta ebirungi. Toggwaamu maanyi.

Ekyokulabirako: Dr. Ben Carson

Dr. Ben Carson yakulira mu bwavu mu Amerika. Nnyina yali tasobola kusoma bulungi, naye yalagira batabani be okusoma ebitabo bibiri buli wiiki n'okuwandiika lipoota ku byo. Ben yasooka kufuna buzibu mu ssomero. Ne banne abamu baamuyita musiru. Naye olw'okukola ennyo, okusaba, n'okuzzibwamu amaanyi nnyina, yafuuka omu ku basawo ab'obwongo abamanyiddwa ennyo mu nsi yonna.

Olugero lwe lutuyigiriza nti ensibuko yo si y'egera ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso. Ekikulu ye ndowooza yo, okukkiriza kwo, n'okwefuga kwo. Oyinza okuwangula embeera yonna n'obuyambi bwa Katonda.

"Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi." — Abafiripi 4:13

Ekyokulabirako: Stephen Kiprotich

Stephen Kiprotich yakulira mu kyalo ekitono mu Uganda. Yeetendeka ng'adduka ebbanga eddene nga talina ngatto. Abantu bangi baamubuusabuusa, naye n'asigala nga yeekaliriza. Mu 2012, yawangula omudaali gwa zaabu ogwa Uganda ogwasooka mu Mizannyo gy'Olimpiki mu myaka amakumi ana.

Kiprotich oluvannyuma yagamba nti okukkiriza kwe mu Katonda n'okwefuga kwe okwa buli lunaku bye byali ebisumuluzo by'obuwanguzi bwe. Yagolokokanga mu makya, ne yeetendeka nnyo, era teyeerabira gy'ava. Olugero lwe lutujjukiza nti ekigendererwa kyetaagisa okugumiikiriza, n'okugumiikiriza kwetaagisa okukkiriza.

Okuzuula Ekigendererwa Kyo Kyennyini

Ozuula otya ekigendererwa kyo? Tandika n'okusaba n'okusaba Katonda akulage. Ye mutandisi w'obulamu bwo. Mala ekiseera ng'omusaba akuluŋŋamye ebigere byo. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yasaba nti: "Ondage amakubo go, Ayi Mukama, onjigirize ekkubo lyo." (Zabbuli 25:4)

Fumiitiriza ku ebyo by'oyagala n'ebirabo byo. Masomo ki g'onyumirwa? Mirimu ki egikuwa amaanyi? Katonda emirundi mingi akozesa ky'oyagala okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyo.

Beeranga mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono. Ekigendererwa kitandika n'ebigere ebitono: okutuuka mu budde, okumaliriza emirimu gy'awaka, n'okuyamba abalala. Yesu yagamba nti, "Omwesigwa mu kitono ennyo, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene." (Lukka 16:10)

Noonya okuwabulwa okw'amagezi. Yogera n'abasomesa bo, abasumba, oba abazadde bo. Katonda emirundi mingi ayogerera mu bantu. Era yongera okuyiga. Gy'okoma okukula, gy'okoma Katonda okukukozesa.

Ekigendererwa Kireeta Obulagirizi

Awataba kigendererwa, obulamu buwuguuka. Ovaayo ng'okoppa abalala oba ng'ogoberera ekibiina. Naye bw'omanya gw'oli n'ensonga lwaki oli wano, obeerawo n'obwesige.

Dawudi bwe yayolekagana ne Goliyaasi, yali mulenzi buto bwokka. Naye yamanya ekigendererwa kye. Yagamba nti: "Mukama eyamponya enjala z'empologoma n'enjala z'eddubu, alimponya ne mu mukono gw'Omufirisuuti oyo." (1 Samwiri 17:37) Dawudi yakkiriza nti Katonda yali amuteekeddeteekedde olw'akaseera ako kennyini. Mu ngeri y'emu, Katonda akuteekerateekera ebintu by'otannasobola kulaba.

Okubeera n'Okwolesebwa

Wandiika ebirooto byo. Kuumanga akatabo akatono mw'owandiika ky'oyagala okukolera Katonda n'ekitundu ky'obeeramu. Kiyinza okuba okufuuka omusomesa, omusawo, omuyinjiniya, omulimi, nannyini bizinensi, oba omusumba. Ka kibe kyonna, kiwaayo eri Katonda omusabe akikole bulungi.

"Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi ate omubaka gwe banaatuma, akutwale bunnambiro." — Kaabakuuku 2:2

Bw'oba n'okwolesebwa okw'amazima, ojja kusoma n'obunyiikivu, n'owewala ebikutataaganya, era n'oyongerayo ne bwe biba bizibu.

Ekigendererwa n'Obuweereza

Ekigendererwa si kwo kufuna buwanguzi bwo bwokka. Kikwata ku buweereza. Obukulu obw'amazima buva mu kuyamba abalala. Yesu yagamba nti, "Asinga obukulu mu mmwe y'anaabeeranga omuweereza wammwe." (Matayo 23:11)

Ka Katonda akuyite okukola kyonna, kikole n'omutima ogw'okuweereza. Omusomesa aweereza ng'ayita mu kuyigiriza. Omusawo aweereza ng'ayita mu kulabirira. Omusuubuzi aweereza ng'ayita mu mulimu ogw'obwesigwa n'okugaba. Bw'obeerera okuwa abalala omukisa, ozuula essanyu ery'amazima.

Okufumiitiriza

  • Birooto byo bye biruwa?
  • Birabo ki oba by'oyagala ki Katonda by'atadde mu mutima gwo?
  • Oyinza otya okuweereza abalala kaakano, ne mu bintu ebitono?

Okusaba

Mukama, weebale okuntonda n'ekigendererwa. Njigiriza okutambulira mu kwagala kwo. Nnyamba okuzuula n'okukuza ebirabo by'ompadde. Mpa amaanyi nsome nnyo, mpeereze abalala, era mbeerere ekitiibwa kyo. Luŋŋamya ebigere byange buli lunaku. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

Mirimu ki egikuwa amaanyi? Katonda emirundi mingi akozesa ky'oyagala okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyo. Beeranga mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono. Gy'okoma okukula, gy'okoma Katonda okukukozesa. Ekigendererwa Kireeta Obulagirizi Awataba kigendererwa, obulamu buwuguuka. Ovaayo ng'okoppa abalala oba ng'ogoberera ekibiina. Naye bw'omanya gw'oli n'ensonga lwaki oli wano, obeerawo n'obwesige. Dawudi bwe yayolekagana ne Goliyaasi, yali mulenzi buto bwokka. Naye yamanya ekigendererwa kye. Okubeera n'Okwolesebwa Wandiika ebirooto byo. Kuumanga akatabo akatono mw'owandiika ky'oyagala okukolera Katonda n'ekitundu ky'obeeramu. Kiyinza okuba okufuuka omusomesa, omusawo, omuyinjiniya, omulimi, nannyini bizinensi, oba omusumba. Ka kibe kyonna, kiwaayo eri Katonda omusabe akikole bulungi. "Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi ate omubaka gwe banaatuma, akutwale bunnambiro." — Kaabakuuku 2:2 Bw'oba n'okwolesebwa okw'amazima, ojja kusoma n'obunyiikivu, n'owewala ebikutataaganya, era n'oyongerayo ne bwe biba bizibu. Ekigendererwa n'Obuweereza Ekigendererwa si kwo kufuna buwanguzi bwo bwokka. Kikwata ku buweereza. Obukulu obw'amazima buva mu kuyamba abalala. fields.title: Amaanyi g'Obunyiikivu n'Okwefuga
fields.body_html:
"Enteekateeka z'omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere, naye okwanguyiriza okutalina nteekateeka kuvaamu bwavu." — Engero 21:5

Obunyiikivu: Ekyama Ekiri Emabega w'Obuwanguzi Bwonna Obukulu

Buli muntu awangula, oba mu ssomero, mu bizinensi, oba mu buweereza, alina ekintu kimu kye bafaanana: obunyiikivu. Obunyiikivu kitegeeza okufuba okunywevu, okw'obwegendereza, era okutasalako. Kitegeeza okukola kyonna ky'osobola ne bw'oba nga toyagala.

Abayizi bangi basabira obuwanguzi naye ne beerabira nti Katonda awa omukisa omulimu omuzibu. Okusaba n'okukkiriza bya maanyi, naye biteekwa okwegattibwa n'okufuba. Ne Yesu, wadde nga yali ajjudde amagezi aga Katonda, yakola nnyo era yali yeefuga mu mulimu gwe.

"Buli kye mukola mukikole n'omutima gwammwe gwonna, ng'abakolera Mukama so si abantu." — Abakkolosaayi 3:23

Obunyiikivu bufuula ebirooto okuba amazima. Oyinza okuba n'ebiruubirirwa ebinene, naye awatali kufuba kwa buli lunaku, bisigala kwegomba kwokka. Nga ebirime bwe bitakula mu kiro kimu, obuwanguzi bwetaagisa ekiseera, obugumiikiriza, n'okwefuga.

Okwefuga Kye Ki?

Okwefuga bwe busobozi bw'okwefuga okukola ekituufu, ne bwe kiba kizibu. Kitegeeza okusoma ng'osinziira okwagala okwebaka, okumaliriza emirimu gy'awaka nga tonnaba kuzannya mupiira, n'okutuukiriza ebisuubizo byo. Okwefuga lwe lutindo oluva ku biruubirirwa okutuuka ku kubituukiriza.

"Okukangavvulwa kwonna mu biro ebya kaakano tekufaanana nga kwa ssanyu, wabula kwa bulumi; naye oluvannyuma kuleetera abo abakuyigirizibwamu ebibala eby'obutuukirivu n'emirembe." — Abaebbulaniya 12:11

Lowooza ku muddusi. Embagirawo ng'empaka tezinnatuuka, agolokoka mu makya okwetendeka. Alya emmere entuufu, awummula obulungi, era yeewala ebimutataaganya. Obuwanguzi bwe ku lunaku olw'empaka businziira ku kwefuga kwe yamala emyezi mingi ng'akikola. Kye kimu ne mu by'okusoma ne mu bulamu. Omuyizi eyeefuga talinda kutuusa kiro ekisembayo nga tannaba kutandika kusoma. Ateekateeka, ne yeetegeka, era n'asigala nga tasalako.

Bayibuli Bw'ayogera ku Bunyiikivu

Bayibuli ejjudde okuzzibwamu amaanyi okukola ennyo. Engero 6:6-8 wagamba nti: "Yigira ku biwuka, mugayaavu ggwe; fumiitiriza engeri gye bikolamu obiyigireko! Tebirina mukulembeze, mukungu oba mufuzi yenna abikulembera, kyokka byekuŋŋaanyiza emmere mu biseera eby'amakungula, ne bitereka emmere mu biseera ebituufu mu mwaka." Akawuka akatono kayigiriza essomo eddene. Kakola nnyo ne bwe wataba muntu akalaba.

Yesu bwe yagera olugero lwa ttalanta (Matayo 25:14-30), yatendereza abaddu abaakola n'obunyiikivu ne bongeza kye baaweebwa. Omuddu omugayaavu eyaziika ttalanta ye n'agifiirwa. Essomo litegeerekeka: Katonda atusuubira okukozesa n'okukuza ebirabo by'atateeka mu ffe.

Ekyokulabirako: Okwefuga kwa Dr. Ben Carson

Abaana abalala nga balaba tterevi, Ben Carson yasoma ebitabo. Yasoma ssaayansi era n'aloota okuba omusawo ne bwe baamusekereranga. Yagamba nti: "Ng'oyita mu kukola ennyo, okugumiikiriza, n'okukkiriza mu Katonda, oyinza okutuukiriza ebirooto byo." Obulamu bwe butuyigiriza nti okwefuga kwa maanyi okusinga ekirabo eky'obuzaaliranwa. Oyinza obutaba muyizi asinga okuba n'ebirabo mu kibiina kyo, naye n'obunyiikivu, oyinza okusukka ennyo abo abeesiga busobozi bwokka.

Ekyokulabirako: Okwekaliriza kwa Stephen Kiprotich

Stephen Kiprotich teyawangula maratoni ya Olimpiki lwa mukisa. Obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku bwajjula okwefuga. Yaddukanga mu makya ennyo ng'enjuba tennavaayo. Yeegenderezanga ky'alya. Yeetendekanga ne bwe yabanga akooye, era teyaganya nsonga za kwekwasa kumuziyiza. Bwe yayimirira ku ntebe y'ekitiibwa eya Olimpiki ng'akutte bendera ya Uganda, ensi yalaba bbanga ttono lyokka ery'obuwanguzi. Emabega w'obuwanguzi obwo waaliwo emyaka mingi egy'okwefuga okutalabika. Obuwanguzi emirundi mingi bulabika mu lujjudde, naye okwetegeka kubaawo mu kyama.

Empisa Ennungi ez'Okusoma

Teekawo enteekateeka y'obudde. Teekateeka olunaku lwo era ogabe obudde obw'enjawulo ku kusoma, okuwummula, n'okwesanyusaamu. Tosomanga bw'owulira okusoma kwokka. Kiteekateeke n'obwegendereza.

Ddamu okwekenneenya buli lunaku. Oluvannyuma lw'okusoma mu kibiina, yita mu bye wawandiika nga bikyali biggya mu birowoozo. Ne dakiika 30 ez'okwekenneenya buli lunaku ziyinza okuleeta enjawulo ennene.

Buuza ebibuuzo. Abayizi abanyiikivu baagala okumanya. Bw'oba totegeera kintu, buuza omusomesa wo oba mu ye gw'osoma naye.

Kozesa obulungi enkya zo. Makya ennyo emirundi mingi ge budde obusinga obulungi okusaba, okusoma Bayibuli, n'okusoma. Obwongo bwo buba obuggya era ebikutataaganya biba bitono.

Wummulangako. Kola nnyo, naye era owummule. Ne Katonda yawummula ku lunaku olw'omusanvu. Beeranga munywevu mu bikolwa okusinga okusoma buteesateesa nga ebibuuzo binaatera okutuuka.

Saba nga tonnaba kusoma ne bw'omaliriza okusoma. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuyambe okutegeera. Katonda afaayo ku kuyiga kwo n'okusinga bw'ofaayo ggwe.

Okwenkanyankanya Ebyessomero n'Obulamu

Abayizi bangi mu Uganda balina obuvunaanyizibwa obulala ng'oggyeeko essomero, gamba ng'okuyamba mu mirimu gy'awaka, okukima amazzi, okufumba, oba okukola emirimu egy'akaseera. Obunyiikivu tekitegeeza kunyooma buvunaanyizibwa buno. Kitegeeza okuyiga okubwenkanyankanya n'amagezi.

Teekateeka obudde bwo osobole okutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bw'omu maka ate era n'ossaayo omwoyo ku by'essomero. Bayibuli agamba nti, "Buli mulimu ogukolebwa n'amaanyi gubaako amagoba, naye okwogera obwogezi kireeta bwavu bwokka." (Engero 14:23) Weewale okwemulugunya oba okwegeraageranya n'abalala abalina obudde obw'eddembe obungi. Kozesa obulungi obudde bwo. Oluusi ne dakiika 30 ez'okusoma nga wessizeeko omwoyo ziyinza okutuukiriza ebisinga essaawa nnyingi ez'okusoma nga otataaganyizibwa.

Okuwangula Obugayaavu n'Ensonga z'Okwekwasa

Obugayaavu emirundi mingi bujja nga bwekwese mu kiwummulo. Bwogerera mu kaama nti: "Osaanidde okuwummulako." Oba nti: "Oyinza okukikola enkya." Oba nti: "Buli omu omulala awummula." Naye obugayaavu bubba ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso, ensonga entono emu ku lulala.

"Otulo otutonotono, n'okusumagira akatono, n'okufunya emikono okuwummulako, obwavu bulikutuukako ng'omutemu." — Engero 6:10-11

Eky'okukola si kwewulira musango, wabula okutwala ebigere ebitono era ebinywevu eby'obukolwa. Tandika emirimu gy'awaka. Ddamu okwekenneenya essomo limu. Soma essuula emu. Bw'otandika, amaanyi geeyongera. Jjukira: okwefuga kutandika n'okusalawo kumu okutono.

Ekyokulabirako: Okwefuga kwa Danyeri

Danyeri yali muvubuka eyatwalibwa mu buwaŋŋanguse mu Babulooni. Ne mu nsi ey'obugwira, yasigala mwesigwa era nga yeefuga. Yagaana okulya emmere ya kabaka eyandimwonoonyesezza, era yasoma n'obwegendereza obungi. Bayibuli agamba nti: "Buli nsonga ey'amagezi n'ey'okutegeera kabaka gye yababuuzanga, baali bagitegeera emirundi kkumi okusinga abasawo n'abafumu bonna, mu bwakabaka bwe bwonna." (Danyeri 1:20)

Obuwanguzi bwa Danyeri bwava mu kugatta kwe okw'okukkiriza, obwesimbu, n'okukola ennyo. Yasabanga bulijjo, yasoma n'obunyiikivu, era yawa Katonda ekitiibwa ng'ayita mu kwefuga kwe. Omwoyo ogwo gwe gumu ogw'obulungi guyinza okukuyimusa wonna w'oli.

Okukozesa Obudde: Ekisumuluzo eky'Okwefuga

Katonda awa buli muntu essaawa 24 ze zimu mu lunaku, naye si buli muntu azikozesa mu ngeri y'emu. Abayizi ab'amagezi batwala obudde ng'ekirabo.

"Otuyigirize okutegeeranga obulungi ennaku zaffe, tulyoke tubeere n'omutima ogw'amagezi." — Zabbuli 90:12

Ssaawo ebikulu okusooka. Kola ebisooka okusooka: emirimu gy'awaka nga tonnazannya, n'okusaba nga tonnaba kukozesa mikutu gy'empuliziganya. Weewale ebifuja obudde ng'okwogera obwogezi okungi oba okuwewera essimu ekiseera kyonna. Weetegeke mu maaso. Longoosa akkero ako ekiro ekyasooka olyoke owonye okweraliikirira mu makya. Era owummule obulungi. Ebaka mu budde okusobola okugolokoka ng'ozzeemu amaanyi. Okwefuga era kitegeeza okuwummula obulungi.

Ekyokulabirako: Wangari Maathai

Wangari Maathai ow'e Kenya yayolekagana n'ebizibu bingi ng'akyali muwala muto: obwavu, emikisa emitono eri abawala, n'okuwakanyizibwa bwe yayogerera obutonde bw'ensi. Naye yasoma nnyo, n'afuuka omusayansi, era oluvannyuma n'afuuka omukazi Omuwafirika owaasooka okufuna Ekirabo kya Nobel eky'Emirembe. Yali agamba nti: "Gy'okoma okwambuka waggulu, gy'okoma abantu okuba abatono, kubanga si buli muntu ayagala okwambuka." Yongera okwambuka, ekigere kimu ku kirala.

Okufumiitiriza

  • Okozesa otya obudde bwo buli lunaku?
  • Oli munywevu mu by'okusoma byo ne mu buvunaanyizibwa bwo?
  • Mpisa ki entono z'oyinza okuzimba wiiki eno okufuuka omunyiikivu okusingawo?

Okusaba

Mukama, nnyamba okuba omunyiikivu mu by'okusoma byange era nga neefuga mu bulamu bwange. Njigiriza okukozesa obudde bwange n'amagezi era okukola n'obulungi mu buli kye nkola. Nsonyiwa olw'ebiseera bye nnabeeranga omugayaavu oba atafaayo. Njjuza amaanyi n'okwekaliriza, ndyoke ndeete ekitiibwa eri erinnya lyo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

Weewale ebifuja obudde ng'okwogera obwogezi okungi oba okuwewera essimu ekiseera kyonna. Weetegeke mu maaso. Longoosa akkero ako ekiro ekyasooka olyoke owonye okweraliikirira mu makya. Era owummule obulungi. Ebaka mu budde okusobola okugolokoka ng'ozzeemu amaanyi. Okwefuga era kitegeeza okuwummula obulungi. Ekyokulabirako: Wangari Maathai Wangari Maathai ow'e Kenya yayolekagana n'ebizibu bingi ng'akyali muwala muto: obwavu, emikisa emitono eri abawala, n'okuwakanyizibwa bwe yayogerera obutonde bw'ensi. Naye yasoma nnyo, n'afuuka omusayansi, era oluvannyuma n'afuuka omukazi Omuwafirika owaasooka okufuna Ekirabo kya Nobel eky'Emirembe. Okusaba Mukama, nnyamba okuba omunyiikivu mu by'okusoma byange era nga neefuga mu bulamu bwange. Njigiriza okukozesa obudde bwange n'amagezi era okukola n'obulungi mu buli kye nkola. Nsonyiwa olw'ebiseera bye nnabeeranga omugayaavu oba atafaayo. Njjuza amaanyi n'okwekaliriza, ndyoke ndeete ekitiibwa eri erinnya lyo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.title: Amagezi: Eky’Obugagga Ekisinga Byonna
fields.body_html:
"Mu kutya Mukama amagezi mwe gasookera, era n’okumanya oyo Omutukuvu Katonda, kwe kutegeera." — Engero 9:10

Lwaki Amagezi Gasinga Obukalabakalaba

Abayizi bangi bakkiriza nti obuwanguzi buva mu kuba omukalabakalaba kyokka. Naye amagezi gasinga nnyo obukalabakalaba. Obukalabakalaba kwe kumanya ebintu. Amagezi kwe kumanya engeri y’okukozesaamu ebintu ebyo obulungi. Omuyizi ayinza okukwata mu mutwe enfoomu zonna naye n’alemererwa mu bulamu bw’aba nga talina kusalawo kulungi mu mpisa.

Sulemaani teyasaba Katonda bugagga wadde ttutumu, wabula yasaba amagezi okufuga obulungi. Yasaba nti: "Kale omuddu wo muwe amagezi okufuganga abantu bo, njawulenga ekirungi n’ekibi." (1 Bassekabaka 3:9) Olwokubanga Sulemaani yassa amagezi ku muwendo omungi, Katonda yamuwa ne ebirala byonna. Amagezi gakulaga engeri y’okulowoozaamu, so si ekyokulowoozaako kyokka.

Ensibuko y’Amagezi Amazima

Baibuli eyigiriza nti amagezi amazima gasookera mu kutya Mukama. Kuno si kutya kwa ntiisa, wabula kussaamu kitiibwa n’okwagala Katonda. Bw’omuwa ekitiibwa, ofuna endowooza entuufu. Otandika okulaba ensi ng’oyita mu maaso ge.

"Naye obanga omuntu yenna ku mmwe aweebuka mu magezi, asabenga Katonda agabira bonna atakayuka, galimuweebwa." — Yakobo 1:5

Katonda ayagala nnyo okuwa amagezi abo abagasaba n’omutima ogutuufu.

Danyeri ne Mikwano gye: Amagezi mu Nsi Endala

Danyeri, Saddulaaki, Mesaki, ne Abeduneego baayiga olulimi n’ebiwandiiko by’e Babulooni. Tebaagaana kuyiga. Wabula, baagatta okuyiga n’okukkiriza. Baibuli egamba nti: "Abavubuka abo abana, Katonda n’abawa amagezi n’okutegeera eby’okuyiga eby’engeri zonna." (Danyeri 1:17) Beeyawula kubanga baasooka kussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa. Olugero lwabwe lulaga nti oyinza okuba omulungi ennyo mu ssomero ate n’oba ow’omwoyo nnyo.

Kabaka Sulemaani ne Kabaka Omukazi w’e Seeba

Kabaka omukazi w’e Seeba bwe yawulira ku magezi ga Sulemaani, yatambula olugendo oluwanvu okujja okumugezesa n’ebibuuzo ebizibu (1 Bassekabaka 10). Yeewuunya nnyo, si lwa lubiri lwe lwokka, naye n’olw’okutegeera kwe. Amagezi amazima gasikiriza abalala era galeetera omukisa ku bitundu byonna, so si ku muntu omu yekka. Abayizi b’e Uganda abatambulira mu magezi basobola okukyusa amasomero, amaka, bizinensi, ekkanisa, era n’amawanga.

Amakubo ag’Enkola ag’Okukulira mu Magezi

Tya Katonda ng’ogondera Ekigambo kye ne mu kyama. Soma Ebyawandiikibwa buli lunaku, naddala Engero ne Zabbuli, ebijjudde obulagirizi obw’enkola. Noonya okuluŋŋamizibwa ng’osaba amagezi eri abazadde, abakadde, abasomesa, n’abasumba.

Fumiitiriza nga tonnaba kukola. Weebuuze nti: "Okusalawo kuno kujja kusanyusa Katonda?" Yiga okuva mu nsobi zo, kubanga okugwa kuyinza okukuyigiriza singa omutima gwo gusigala nga gwetoowaza.

"Ssangayo omwoyo ku magezi agakuweebwa ne ku kuyigirizibwa, oluvannyuma lwa byonna oliba n’amagezi." — Engero 19:20

Amagezi n’Empisa

Amagezi galeeta okwetoowaza, obwesimbu, n’emirembe. Gakuyamba okwewala ennyombo, obukuusa, n’amakubo ag’ekikumpanya. Omuyizi ow’amagezi amanyi nti okukola obulungi kuyinza okuba okuzibu leero, naye bulijjo ke kkubo ekisingako obukuumi ku nkya.

  • Mu bitundu ki eby’obulamu mw’oyagala amagezi ennyo: mu mikwano, mu kusoma, oba mu kusalawo okwa buli lunaku?
  • Ani mu bulamu bwo alaga amagezi ag’okutya Katonda g’oyinza okuyigirako?

Mukama, mpa amagezi agava waggulu. Onnyambe okutegeera Ekigambo kyo n’okusalawo obulungi buli lunaku. Okuyiga kwange kuleetere Ggwe ekitiibwa era kugase abalala. Amiina.

fields.title: Engeri y’Okusomamu Obulungi
fields.body_html:
"Buli kye mukola mukikole n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga mukolera Mukama waffe." — Abakkolosaayi 3:23

Okusoma nga Kusinza

Okusoma, okuddamu okusoma, n’okuyiga byonna biyinza okuba ebikolwa eby’okusinza bwe bikolebwa n’omutima omutuufu. Katonda asanyuka bw’okozesa obwongo bwo obulungi. Bw’osoma n’obwesimbu, oweesa Katonda eyakuwa obwongo bwo ekitiibwa.

"Omanyi omuntu omukugu mu mulimu gwe? Aliweereza bakabaka." — Engero 22:29

Lwaki Abayizi Bangi Balaba Ennaku

Ensonga ezimanyiddwa mulimu: obutaba na nteekateeka, empisa embi ez’okusoma, ebibungeeza gamba nga essimu oba mikwano, okutya n’okweraliikirira, n’okutassaayo mwoyo ku buyambi bwa Katonda. Bino byonna biyinza okuwangulwa nga tuyita mu nteekateeka, okusaba, n’obugumu.

Ekyokulabirako kya Pawulo Omutume

Nga tannakyuka mutima, Pawulo yayigira wansi wa Gamalyeri, omu ku basomesa abasinga obulungi mu Isirayiri (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 22:3). Ne bwe yamala okusisinkana Yesu, Pawulo yeeyongera okusoma n’okwogeraganya n’obwegendereza. Ebbaluwa ze ziraga obwongo obutegese obuluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Obunyiikivu obw’omwoyo n’obukugu mu by’okuyiga bisobola okubeera mu muntu omu.

Enkola z’Okusoma Ezikola

Beeranga n’ekiruubirirwa ekitegeevu. Manya lwaki osoma buli ssomo. Kozesa entegeka y’ebiseera era ogabanye ebisomwa mu wiiki. Wandiika obubaka mu bigambo byo ggwe, so si okukoppa kyokka. Ddangamu bulijjo ng’oyita mu kuddamu okusoma okumpi era okwa buli kiseera okuzimba ebijjukizo.

Kozesa empapula z’ebibuuzo ebyayita olyoke otegeere engeri ebibuuzo gye biteekebwateekebwa. Yigiriza abalala by’osoma, kubanga okunnyonnyola ekintu kukuyamba okukijjukira. Saba nga tonnaba kusoma era oyite Omwoyo Omutukuvu abikkule endowooza yo.

"Omwoyo Omutukuvu alibayigiriza ebintu byonna." — Yokaana 14:26

Embeera Gy’Osoomeramu ya Mugaso

Noonya ekifo ekisirikkirivu, ekiyonjo, era ekiriko ekitangaala ekimala okusoma. Ssimu yo gireke wala. Tegeeza mikwano n’ab’omu maka essaawa z’osoma balyoke bakuwagire. Amasannyalaze bwe gagenda, teekateeka okukozesa ekitangaala ky’emisana oba weegatte ku bibinja by’okusomera awamu ku ssomero.

Empisa Ennungi eri Obwongo

Lya emmere ey’ensukusa, weebake essaawa musanvu okutuuka ku munaana buli kiro, nywa amazzi agamala, era weezannyese buli kiseera. Omubiri ogw’amaanyi guyamba obwongo obw’amaanyi. Ne Yesu yennyini yafuna ekiseera okuwummula (Makko 6:31).

Okukwata Ebibuuzo mu Ngeri ya Katonda

Saba, weetegeke, era weesige Katonda. Tobbanga, kubanga obubbi buzikiriza obwesimbu. Yingira mu kisenge ky’ebibuuzo ng’omanyi nti okoze kyonna ky’osobola, era weesige Katonda okukola ekisigadde.

"Atambulira mu bwesimbu atambula mirembe." — Engero 10:9

Ekyokulabirako: Grace ow’e Mbarara

Grace yakulira ng’asoma ku ttabaaza y’omusubbaawa. Yakola obubaka obumpi obw’okujjukiza, yaddangamu buli lunaku, era yasabanga buli nkya. Oluvannyuma yafuuka omusomesa eyayamba abawala abalala okusoma n’amagezi. Obuwanguzi bwe tebwava mu kuba n’ebintu eby’okwejalabya, wabula mu kwefuga n’okukkiriza.

Okufumiitiriza

  • Kiki ekisinga okukubungeeza ng’osoma?
  • Nkyukakyuka ki emu gy’oyinza okukola ku mpisa zo ez’okusoma wiiki eno?

Okusaba

Mukama Yesu, nnyamba nkozese obwongo bwange obulungi. Mpa okussa omwoyo ku kimu, okujjukira, n’emirembe. Okusoma kwange kuleetere Ggwe ekitiibwa era kugase abalala. Amiina.

fields.title: Okuwangula Obugayaavu n’Okulwaza Emirimu
fields.body_html:
"Yigira ku biwuka, mugayaavu ggwe; fumiitiriza engeri gye bikolamu obeere n’amagezi!" — Engero 6:6

Olutalo olw’Omunda

Buli muyizi asisinkana amaloboozi abiri: erimu ligamba nti "Kola kaakano" n’eddala ligamba nti "Olikola oluvannyuma." Obugayaavu n’okulwaza emirimu babbi ba kasirise. Babba ebiseera, amanya, n’ebiseera eby’omu maaso. Setaani si bulijjo akema n’ebibi ebinene. Oluusi awunyiriza buwunyirizi nti: "Wummulako katono, olwo n’oluvannyuma n’owummulako nate."

Okutegeera Okulwaza Emirimu

Okulwaza emirimu kitegeeza okuddiza ekyo ky’osaanidde okukola kaakano kubanga kiwulikika nga kizibu oba nga kikooya. Emirimu tegibula ng’ogiddiza. Gyeyongera okwetuuma, era gy’olwawo, gyeyongera okuzitowa.

"Oyo alabirira embuyaga talisiga; n’oyo atunuulira ebire talikungula." — Omubuulizi 11:4

Okulinda embeera entuufu ddala kyokka kutwala kya kufukula. Tandikira w’oli, n’ekyo ky’olina, leero.

Okulabula kwa Baibuli ku Bugayaavu

Engero 24:30-34 zoogera ku nnimiro y’omugayaavu ng’ebunye amaggwa. Okulagajjalira bulijjo kuvaamu okufiirwa. Katonda ayita abaana be okubala ebibala n’okuba abanyiikivu.

fields.title: Obwesimbu n’Empisa
fields.body_html:
"Obwesimbu bw’abatuukirivu bubaluŋŋamya, naye enkwe z’abatali beesigwa zibazikirizisa." — Engero 11:3

Obwesimbu: Amaanyi Amakweke ag’Obulamu Obukulu

Obwesimbu kitegeeza okuba omwesigwa, ow’amazima, era atakyukakyuka mu buli ky’okola. Kitegeeza okulonda ekituufu, ne bwe wataba muntu akulaba. Lowooza ku bwesimbu ng’omugongo gw’obulamu bwo obw’empisa. Bugukuuma nga bugolokofu. Awatali bwo, buli mpisa endala ku nkomerero egwa.

Omutima gwo bwe guba mutuufu eri Katonda, teweetaaga kulaga maaso ga njawulo eri abantu ab’enjawulo. Oba muntu omu mu kibiina, mu maka, ne mu kkanisa. Ensi eyinza okussa ekitiibwa ku ndabika ey’okungulu, naye Katonda assa ekitiibwa ku mazima ag’omunda.

"Abantu batunuulira bya kungulu naye Mukama atunuulira bya mu mutima." — 1 Samwiri 16:7

Obwesimbu si bulijjo bufuula obulamu okwangu, naye bulijjo buleeta obulamu obulimu amakulu. Oyinza okufiirwa empeera ez’akaseera, naye ofuna emirembe egy’ekiseera ekiwanvu.

Ebyokulabirako eby’Obwesimbu

Yusufu mu Misiri: bwe yakemebwa muka Potifali, yagaana ekibi, ng’agamba nti: "Kale nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu kwonoona okwenkanidde awo n’okusobya eri Katonda?" (Olubereberye 39:9) Yabonerezebwa awatali nsonga, naye obwesimbu bwe oluvannyuma bwamuggya mu kkomera ne bumutuusa mu lubiri.

Danyeri mu Babulooni: Danyeri yagaana okulya emmere eyeeyonoona oba okulekeraawo okusaba, ne bwe yatiisibwatiisibwa n’okufa. Obunnya bw’empologoma ne bufuuka ebbeetu ery’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Obwesimbu tebukwata ku kwejalabya. Bukwata ku kunywerera ku ky’okkiririzaamu.

Yesu yennyini: bwe yawaayirizibwa, yasigala nga w’amazima era nga musirise mu kifo ky’okwewolereza n’obulimba. Obulamu bwe bulaga nti obwesimbu n’okwewaayo emirundi mingi bitambulira wamu.

Lwaki Obwesimbu Bukulu eri Abayizi

Mu mirimu gy’essomero, gaana okukoppa oba okubba, ne bwe kiba nga abalala bakikola. Mu nkolagana, yogera amazima era otuukirize ebisuubizo byo. Ku by’ensimbi, zaawo ebyo bye weewola era okozese ebyo bye waweebwa n’amagezi. Ku yintaneeti, teeka era osaagaanye ebyo byokka ebiweesa Katonda ekitiibwa. Buli kikolwa ekitono eky’amazima kinyweza omusingi gwo. Buli bulimba obutono bugunafuya.

"Omuntu omutuukirivu, atambulira mu bulamu obutaliiko kyakunenyezebwa; ba mukisa abaana be abalimuddira mu bigere." — Engero 20:7

Ebyokulabirako by’omu Afirika

Florence Nankinga, omusomesa Omunnayuganda, lumu yagaana enguzi omuzadde gye yamuwa okuyimusa amaka g’omuyizi. Yayolekera okunenyezebwa naye n’aweebwa ekitiibwa ekinene mu kitundu. Emyaka egiyita, omuzadde oyo omu yamwebaza olw’obwesimbu bwe.

Allen Kagina, amanyiddwa olw’obwesimbu bwe mu Uganda Revenue Authority, yayonja enkwe ez’obuli n’ebyokulabirako, so si na kuleekaana. Yasabanga buli lunaku nga tannasalawo nsonga nkulu.

Desmond Tutu ow’e South Africa yayimirira ng’awakanya obufuzi bwa apartheid naye n’agaana okukyawa abalabe be. Amaanyi ge ag’empisa gaakubiriza omulembe gwonna. Obwesimbu tebulina nsalo. Buli awassibwa ekitiibwa amazima, omukisa gugoberera.

Engeri y’Okuzimbamu Obwesimbu

Beera w’amazima mu bintu ebitono. Bw’olimba ku nsonga entono, olimba ne ku nnene. Kkiriza ensobi zo mangu, kubanga okukkiriza ensobi zo maanyi, so si bunafu. Tuukiriza ebisuubizo byo, kubanga n’obweyamo obutono bwa mugaso eri Katonda. Londa mikwano abaagala amazima, kubanga obwesimbu bukulira bulungi mu bantu abalungi.

"Ayi Mukama, ani anaabeeranga mu nnyumba yo? Oyo ataliiko kya kunenyezebwa, akola eby’obutuukirivu, era ayogera eby’amazima nga biviira ddala mu mutima gwe." — Zabbuli 15:1-2

Obwesimbu bwe Bukusaasaanyisa

Oluusi amazima galeeta obulumi obw’akaseera: okukangavvulwa omusomesa, okufiirwa mikwano, oba okutategeerebwa. Kyokka Katonda alaba era asasula obwesigwa. Kirungi okufiirwa okuganja mu bantu okusinga okufiirwa emirembe ne Katonda. Omusaalaba gwa Kristo bukakafu nti obwesimbu buyinza okulumya, naye butuusa mu kuzuukira.

"Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene." — Lukka 16:10

Okufumiitiriza

  • Ddi lwe wakemebwa okulimba oba okukweka amazima? Kiki kye wayiga okuva mu ekyo?
  • Ani mu bulamu bwo alaga obwesimbu bw’oyinza okuyigirako?
  • Bigambo ki bisatu by’oyagala abalala okukozesa nga bannyonnyola empisa yo mu myaka etaano?

Okusaba

Mukama, njagala okutambulira mu mazima. Njigiriza okwagala obwesimbu okusinga okuganja, obulongoofu okusinga essanyu ery’omubiri, n’okusiimibwa Ggwe okusinga okutenderezebwa abantu. Nyweza empisa yange buli lunaku. Amiina.

fields.title: Omukwano n’Okunyigirizibwa Bannaawo
fields.body_html:
"Oyo atambula n’abantu abagezi ageziwala, naye oyo atambula n’abasirusiru alaba ennaku." — Engero 13:20

Amaanyi g’Omukwano

Omukwano guli mu birabo ebisinga obulungi Katonda bye yatuwa, naye era guli mu bintu ebisinga amaanyi okutuletako obukyuka mu bulamu bwaffe singa tugulondera bubi. Mikwano giyinza okukuzimba oba okukumenya. Gitereeza engeri gy’oyogeramu, gy’okoleramu, n’engeri gy’olowoozaamu ku ggwe wennyini.

Mikwano gyo giri ng’ettaka empisa yo mw’ekulira. Ettaka bwe liba eddamu, nga lijjudde obwesimbu, okukkiriza, n’okuzzaamu amaanyi, ojja kukula obulungi. Naye bwe liba lijjudde endowooza embi, obugayaavu, oba ekibi, emmeeme yo erikala. Omuyizi ow’amagezi ayiga okuba ow’omukwano eri buli muntu naye ng’asemberera abo bokka abamusembeza eri Katonda.

"Ng’ekyuma bwe kiwagala ekyuma, n’omuntu bw’abangula muntu munne." — Engero 27:17

Omukwano mu Baibuli

Dawudi ne Yonasaani: Yonasaani yateeka obulamu bwe mu katyabaga okukuuma Dawudi. Omukwano gwabwe gwazimbibwa ku bwesigwa, okwewaayo, n’okukkiriza Katonda okw’awamu. Omukwano ogw’amazima gukuuma mu kifo ky’okwogera olugambo, era guwagira mu kifo ky’okuvuganya.

Luusi ne Nawomi: Luusi yasigala ne nnyazaala we mu bwavu ne mu kufiirwa, ng’akakasa nti okwagala n’obwesigwa bya muwendo okusinga okwejalabya.

Yesu n’abayigirizwa be: Yesu yayita abagoberezi be "mikwano" (Yokaana 15:15). Yabaagala okumala okubatereeza, okubasonyiwa, ne n’okubafiirira. Omukwano oguzimbiddwa ku Kristo gwa lubeerera.

Amazima ku Kunyigirizibwa Bannaawo

Okunyigirizibwa bannaawo kwe kuba ng’abantu abakwetoolodde bagezaako okukukyusa okukola ekintu, oluusi ekirungi naye emirundi mingi ekibi, olw’okuyagala okutuukagana nabo. Kuyinza okukuleetera okwambala, okwogera, oba okukola mu ngeri ezitakwatagana n’empisa zo. Ku ssomero, okunyigirizibwa bannaawo kuyinza okulabika ng’okukoppa mu bibuuzo kubanga "buli muntu akikola," okuseka abalala okwerabisa nga ow’omulembe, okwenyigira mu lugambo, oba okutandika enkolagana ez’okwagala nga tonnaba kwetegeka.

Okunyigirizibwa bannaawo kuwunyiriza nti: "Bw’otojja kwegatta ku ffe, ojja kuba bw’omu." Naye toli bw’omu n’akatono bw’otambula ne Katonda.

"Temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe." — Abaruumi 12:2

Okutegeera Emikwano Emibi

fields.title: Okuddukanya Enneewulira n’Okweraliikirira
fields.body_html:
"Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira, kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako." — 1 Peetero 5:7

Enneewulira: Ekirabo kya Katonda, So si Mulabe

Enneewulira kitundu ku bulamu bw’omuntu. Katonda yakuwa okuwulira olyoke weegatte naye ne banno mu ngeri ennuma ennyo. Essanyu, ennaku, obusungu, okutya, okusanyuka, n’okwennyamira, byonna bya buzaaliranwa. Ekizibu kitandika ng’enneewulira etandise okukufuga mu kifo ky’okuba nga ggwe ogifuga. Enneewulira eri ng’omuliro: guyamba bwe guzibwako ekkomo, naye gwonoona bwe guleekaanira awo.

Bw’oyiga okuddukanya enneewulira yo ng’oyambibwako Omwoyo wa Katonda, ofuuka w’amaanyi munda.

"Omuntu omugumiikiriza asinga omutabaazi, n’oyo afuga obusungu bwe akira awamba ekibuga." — Engero 16:32

Yesu n’Enneewulira

Yesu yawulira enneewulira ez’amaanyi era n’azikwata bulungi ddala. Mukwano gwe Laazaalo bwe yafa, yakaaba amaziga (Yokaana 11:35). Yeekaalu bwe yafuulibwa akatale, yawulira obusungu obw’obutuukirivu n’agiyonja (Yokaana 2:15-17). Bwe yatunuulira omusaalaba, yawulira ennaku ennyingi naye n’asaba nti: "Naye si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa." (Lukka 22:42)

Yesu atulaga nti okwoleka enneewulira si kibi. Ekikulu ye ngeri gye tuyanukulamu enneewulira zaffe. Ekyama kiri mu kwefuga okujjudde okusaba.

Enneewulira Empitirivu mu Bayizi

Okweraliikirira n’okutya emirundi mingi kuva ku kunyigirizibwa okw’ebibuuzo, essuubi eringi ery’ebituukibwako, oba okweraganya n’abalala. Obusungu buvaayo ng’okoleddwa obutali bwenkanya oba ng’otategeeredwa bulungi. Obwerere bwa bulijjo eri abo abali mu ssomero ery’obusuze oba abali ewala n’ab’omu maka gaabwe. Obuggya buyinza okuva mu kulaba abalala nga bakulaakulana oba nga bafuna okussibwako omwoyo okusingako. Okuggwaamu amaanyi kugoberera okugwa, okunenyezebwa, oba okwolekagana n’ebizibu eby’eka.

Toli munafu olw’okuwulira ebintu bino. Buli omu abiwulira. Ekigendererwa si kunyigiriza nneewulira zo, wabula kuziwaayo eri Katonda.

"Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga." — Abafiripi 4:6-7

Engeri Ennungi ez’Okuddukanya Enneewulira

Saba n’obwesimbu. Tegeeza Katonda bw’owulira ddala. Asobola okugumira obwesimbu bwo. Yogera n’omuntu gw’oesiga, ng’omusomesa, omusumba, oba omulagirizi. Okukweka obulumi kubufuula obuzito okusingawo.

Soma Zabbuli. Dawudi yayoleka buli nneewulira eri Katonda, okuva ku kutya okutuuka ku ssanyu, era n’afuna emirembe. Wummula bulungi, kubanga okukoowa kwongera okweraliikirira. Sonyiwa mangu, kubanga obusungu bufuuka obutwa bwe busigala mu mutima. Era sinza Katonda ng’oyita mu kuyimba, kubanga okutendereza kuggya endowooza yo ku kutya ne kugissa ku kukkiriza.

"Mukama alikuuma mirembe oyo amaliridde okumwesiga mu mutima gwe." — Isaaya 26:3

Ekyokulabirako: John ow’e Gulu

John yali muyizi eyalaba entalo ng’akyali muto mu bukiikakkono bwa Uganda. Ebirooto ebibi n’obusungu byamala naye emyaka mingi. Olunaku olumu, omusomesa yamuyita ku kukuŋŋaana kw’ekibiina ky’essomero. Okusooka yawulirizanga bukozi mu kasirise, naye oluvannyuma n’atandika okusaba asonyiyibwe era afune emirembe. Mpolampola, obukyayi ne bumuvaako. Leero, ayamba abavubuka abalwana n’ebiwundu by’omutima, ng’agamba nti: "Katonda yasooka kuwonya mutima gwange ndyoke nyambe okuwonya abalala." Obulumi obuweebwayo eri Katonda bufuuka ekigendererwa.

Okwetegereza Okuggweererwa Amaanyi

Bw’osoma oba oweereza ennyo awatali kuwummula, oggwaamu amaanyi. Obubonero mwe muli okukoowa okutaggwaawo, okufiirwa okunyiikira, okwanguya okusunguwala, oba amaziga agajja nga tewasuubidde. Ne Yesu yennyini yafunayo ekiseera okuwummula (Makko 6:31). Okuwummula si bugayaavu. Kwe kugondera engeri Katonda gye yakolamu omubiri gwo. Tambulako mu kasirise, sabira ebweru, oba yogera n’omuntu gw’oesiga. Oluusi okuwona kutandikira mu kuwummula.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu Akuyamba Okufuga Enneewulira

Toddukanya nneewulira n’amaanyi go gokka. Omwoyo Omutukuvu abala emirembe, obugumiikiriza, n’okwefuga (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23). Bw’omuyita mu mutima gwo buli lunaku, akkakkanya omuyaga nga tegunnabaawo. Akwogerera mu kasirise munda yo nti: "Emirembe, sirika." Okuyiga okubeera mu ddembe tekukufuula munafu. Kukufuula ow’amagezi.

Okufumiitiriza

  • Nneewulira ki gy’olwanagana nayo okusingira ddala: obusungu, okutya, ennaku, oba okweraliikirira?
  • Mpisa ki empya z’oyinza okuzimba okuddukanya enneewulira ng’oyambibwako Katonda?
  • Kiki ky’oyinza okukola bw’olaba nga mukwano gwo yeeraliikirivu oba aggweddemu amaanyi?

Okusaba

Mukama Yesu, ategeera buli nneewulira gye mpulira. Bwe mba nga neeraliikirivu, beera mirembe gyange. Bwe mba nga nsunguwadde, kkakkanya omutima gwange. Bwe mba nga nnakuwadde, nzijukize okwagala kwo. Njjuza Omwoyo Omutukuvu era onjigirize okuddukanya enneewulira zange n’amagezi n’ekisa. Amiina.

fields.title: Okusaba n’Ekigambo kya Katonda

Ebiziyiza Okusaba

Ebintu ebimu biyinza okuziyiza okusaba kwaffe. Ekibi ekitaatulwa kiyinza okukola ekiziyiza (Zabbuli 66:18). Bayibuli ye Katonda ayogera ku lupapula. Kibikkula omutima gwe, kiyigiriza amazima, era kizza obuggya mu birowoozo byo. Awatali Byawandiikibwa, okusaba kufuuka ng’okwogera wekka. N’Ebyawandiikibwa, okusaba kufuuka bukwano wamu ne Katonda.

Okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa buli lunaku kunaaza obutategeera ne kukujjuza amagezi ga Katonda. Gy’emmere ey’omwoyo. Bw’ogibuuka, olumwa enjala.

Londa ekiseera ekitajjulukuka buli lunaku, oba okwewaayo kwa makya oba nga tonnagenda kwebaka. Saba nga tonnasoma era osabe nti: "Omwoyo Omutukuvu, zibula amaaso gange." Somanga mpola. Obulungi businga obungi. Wandiika by’oyiga mu kitabo ky’obuwandiiko bwa Bayibuli. Gabana by’ozudde ng’otegeeza omuntu amazima agamu ge wayize buli lunaku.

"Ntadde ekigambo kyo mu mutima gwange; ndyoke nneme okwonoona." — Zabbuli 119:11

Mary yalwanagana n’okweraliikirira olw’ebisale by’essomero. Omulagirizi yamuyigiriza okusoma Zabbuli emu buli makya n’okugisabiramu. Nga emyezi gigenda giyitawo, okutya kwe ne kufuuka okukkiriza. Ebyawandiikibwa tebulijjo bikyusa mbeera yo mangu, naye bikyusa ggwe.

Bw’Otowulira Kwagala Kusaba

Buli omu ayita mu biseera eby’enkalu. Ekyo bwe kibaawo, gezaako okusoma Zabbuli mu ddoboozi ery’waggulu n’oleka Ebyawandiikibwa ne bifuuka okusaba kwo. Oyinza n’okuwandiikira Katonda ebbaluwa. Beera wa mazima gy’ali. Amaze okumanya ekiri mu mutima gwo.

  • Otwala okusaba ng’empisa buwedde oba ng’obukwano ne Katonda?
  • Budde ki bw’omaze mu wiiki eno ng’osoma Ekigambo kye?
  • Lunyiriri ki olubadde lwogera ku mbeera yo mu biro bino?

Kitange, weebale olw’okumpuliriza bulijjo. Njigiriza okwagala Ekigambo kyo n’okusaba okuva mu mutima. Eddoboozi lyo liwulikike okusinga okutya kwange. Okusaba n’Ebyawandiikibwa biluŋŋamye buli kigere eky’obulamu bwange. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.body_html:
"Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako." — Matayo 6:33

Obuwanguzi Obw’Amazima Kye Kiki?

Abantu abasinga obungi balowooza nti obuwanguzi kitegeeza bugagga, ettutumu, oba ammaaka amangi. Katonda annyonnyola obuwanguzi mu ngeri endala. Obuwanguzi obw’amazima kwe kukola by’ayagala n’obwesigwa n’okukozesa ebirabo byo okuwa omukisa abalala. Omuyizi omwavu assaamu Katonda ekitiibwa ng’ayita mu bwesimbu n’obunyiikivu, aba muwanguzi mu maaso ga Katonda okusinga omugagga omulyi.

"Kale omuntu agasibwa ki singa alya ensi yonna, naye n’afiirwa obulamu bwe?" — Makko 8:36

Obuwanguzi butandikira munda nga tebunnalabika kungulu.

Ekkubo lya Katonda eritwala ku Buwanguzi

Teeka Katonda mu maaso. Ebikulembeze byo bwe bimuwa ekitiibwa, ye ateekateeka ebirala byonna. Kola n’amaanyi era kola n’amagezi, kubanga obunyiikivu buleeta emikisa. Tambula mu butuukirivu, kubanga empisa esinga ebisatiifikeeti. Weereza abalala, kubanga omukisa gukulukutira eri abo abawa emikisa. Sigala nga weetoowaza, kubanga amalala gaziyiza okukuzibwa.

"Emirimu gyo gyonna gikwasenga Mukama, naye anaatuukirizanga entegeka zo." — Engero 16:3

Ebyokulabirako mu Bayibuli eby’Obuwanguzi obutya Katonda

Yusufu yava mu buddu n’atuuka mu bukulembeze kubanga Mukama yali wamu naye. Danyeeri yeeyongera obulungi mu Babulooni ng’ayita mu kusaba n’okwefuga. Eseza yakozesa ekifo kye n’obuvumu okuwonya abantu be. Pawulo yapima obuwanguzi mu bwesigwa, so si mu kuwummula. Obulamu bwabwe bukakasa nti obuwanguzi kibala ky’obuwulize, so si lwa mukisa.

Ebyokulabirako Ebiggya Okuva mu Afirika

Allen Kagina yakulembera Uganda Revenue Authority n’obwesimbu, ng’agaana enguzi, era ng’akakasa nti obutukuvu bukola ne mu bifo eby’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’oku ntikko mu ggavumenti.

Stephen Kiprotich yeetendeka emyaka mingi, emirundi mingi nga tambadde ngatto, kyokka n’awangula zaabu mu Olympics. Okwefuga kwe kufaanana n’okugumiikiriza kw’omwoyo: obuwanguzi bwetaaga okufuba okwa buli lunaku.

Strive Masiyiwa, omusuubuzi ow’e Zimbabwe, yagamba nti: "Okukkiriza, obwesimbu, n’obulungi obw’ekitalo bye musingi gw’obuwanguzi obuwangaala." Omulimu gwe kaakano gusomesa abavubuka enkumi n’enkumi.

Engeri y’Okwetegekera Obuwanguzi

Loota ne Katonda. Mubuuze nti: "Wankolera ki?" Teekateeka n’obwegendereza ng’owandiika ebigendererwa ebituukika n’ebiseera ebitegeerekeka. Weefuge, kubanga obuwanguzi buwera kufuba ate n’obugayaavu butta ebirooto. Weeyongere okuyiga ng’oyita mu kusoma, okubuuza ebibuuzo, n’okukula mu bukugu. Ddukanya obuwanguzi n’amagezi ng’okozesa emikisa okuyamba abalala mu kifo ky’okubeewuunyisa.

"Naye ojjukiranga Mukama Katonda wo, kubanga y’akuwa obuyinza okufuna obugagga." — Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 8:18

Akabi k’Obuwanguzi Obutatya Katonda

Amalala geerabira Omugabi w’ebirungi byonna. Omululu tegukkuta. Obukuusa gufuna magoba ga kiseera kitono naye guvaamu kufiirwa kwa kiseera kiwanvu. N’okwerabira Katonda kwe kugwa okusingira ddala. Obuwanguzi obutaliimu Katonda buli ng’emmotoka etaliimu lipeeta. Buyinza okulabika obulungi naye tebusobola kutuuka wala.

Obuwanguzi Obusukka Essomero

Abayizi bangi balekeraawo okusaba nga bamaze okuyita ebibuuzo. Naye obuwanguzi obw’amazima buyeeyongera ebbanga eddene ng’ebisatiifikeeti bimaze okusaanawo. Kozesa by’oyize okuyimusa abalala: yigiriza muto wo, weeyimirize mu kitundu kyo, oba weereza mu kkanisa yo. Katonda ayaza ky’ogaba.

"Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa!" — Matayo 25:21

Ebigambo bino ebiva eri Yesu kye kipimo ekisembayo eky’obuwanguzi.

Okufumiitiriza

  • Onnyonnyola otya obuwanguzi mu bulamu bwo?
  • Oli mwetegefu okussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa ne bwe kiba kitegeeza okukulaakulana mpola?
  • Oyinza otya okukozesa ebirabo byo okuweereza abalala kaakano?

Okusaba

Mukama, njigiriza okukusooka okunoonya mu ntegeka zange zonna. Wa omukisa okusoma kwange, ebiseera byange eby’omu maaso, n’omulimu gwange, obuwanguzi bwange bulyoke bukugulumize. Onkuume nga neetoowaza mu buwanguzi era nga mwesigwa mu bikemo. Fuula obulamu bwange obujulizi ku bulungi bwo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.title: Okwolekagana n’Obulemwa n’Okuggwaamu Amaanyi
fields.body_html:
"Omuntu omutuukirivu ne bw’agwa emirundi omusanvu, addamu n’ayimuka." — Engero 24:16

Obulemwa si Nkomerero

Buli muyizi ajja kwolekagana n’obulemwa mu kiseera ekimu: mu ssomero, mu mizannyo, mu bukwano, oba mu kusalawo kw’obulamu. Oyinza okugwa mu kibuuzo, okufiirwa okunyiikira, oba okukola ensobi enakuwaza abalala. Naye obulemwa si nkomerero y’olugero lwo. Buyinza okuba entandikwa y’okukula kwo. Obulemwa si bbugwe. Luggi olutuusa mu magezi, bw’obwolekagana obulungi.

Omwana bw’ayiga okutambula, agwa emirundi mingi. Kyokka buli kugwa kunyweza amagulu ge okutuusa lw’asobola okuddukira ddala. Mu ngeri y’emu, Katonda akkiriza ebiremya okukutendeka, so si okukukwasa ensonyi.

"Mukama awanirira abo bonna abazitoowereddwa, era ayimusa bonna abagwa." — Zabbuli 145:14

Lwaki Katonda Akkiriza Obulemwa

Oluusi Katonda atukkiriza okugwa olw’ensonga eziwera. Ayinza okukozesa obulemwa okutuyigiriza obwetoowaze n’okutujjukiza nti twetaaga obuyambi bwe. Bw’ogwa, tototoloka Katonda. Ddukira gy’ali. Tagaana mutima gwetoowaza.

Wangari Maathai yali yagobebwa mu bikolwa by’obwannakyewa mu yunivasite, era n’abuusibwabuusibwa bannaawe. Yagaana okulekeraawo okukolera obwenkanya n’okulabirira obutonde. Ebiremya bye byafuuka ettaka omwakulira ekikolwa kye eky’ensi yonna.

Stephen Kiprotich teyawangula mpaka ze ez’olubereberye era emirundi mingi yasembanga mu kudduka kw’okwetendeka. Naye buli kuwangulwa kwamwongera obumalirivu okulongooka. Olympics bwe yatuuka, yali yeeteeseteese, n’aleeta eka omudaali gwa zaabu ogusooka gwa Uganda mu myaka amakumi ana.

Okwennyamira bwe kujja, yogera ne Katonda n’obwesimbu. Toweefuula nga byonna biri bulungi. Muyiweeko omutima gwo (Zabbuli 62:8). Oluvannyuma ddamu weekebejje era okyuse: weebuuze ky’oyinza okuyiga n’ekyo ky’oyinza okukola mu ngeri endala omulundi oguddako.

fields.body_html:
"Oyo ayagala abantu okumussaamu ekitiibwa, asaana abeere muweereza waabwe." — Matayo 23:11

Obukulembeze Obw’Amazima Kye Butegeeza

Abantu bangi balowooza nti obukulembeze bwe buyinza oba okufuga: okulagira n’okuweerezebwa. Naye Yesu yannyonnyola obukulembeze mu ngeri empya ddala. Yafukamira n’anaaza abayigirizwa be ebigere, ng’alaga nti obukulembeze butandikira mu bwetoowaze, so si mu malala. Obukulembeze bwe buyinza obuva mu kwagala. Okulembera obulungi bw’oweereza abalala n’essanyu era obutakoowa.

"Kale Nze Mukama wammwe era Omuyigiriza, nga bwe mbanaazizza ebigere, nammwe musaana okunaazagananga ebigere." — Yokaana 13:14-15

Obukulembeze n’Ekitiibwa Bigenda Wamu

Ekitiibwa gwe musingi gw’obukulembeze. Toyinza kukulembera bantu b’onyooma oba b’otofaako. Ekitiibwa kitandikira mu kulaba abalala ng’abaakolebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda.

Mu ssomero, ekitiibwa kirabika bw’olamusa abakulu n’abasomesa n’ekitiibwa, bw’owewala olugambo n’okuvuma, bw’owuliriza nga tosaliddemu, bw’otuukiriza ekigambo kyo, era bw’ofaayo ku abo abanafu oba abakwatibwa ensonyi.

"Muwaŋŋananga ekitiibwa." — Abaruumi 12:10

Okussaamu Obuyinza Ekitiibwa

Oyinza obutakkiriziganya bulijjo n’abasomesa, abazadde, oba abakulembeze abalala, naye Katonda atusaba okubassaamu ekitiibwa kubanga baateekebwa mu bulamu bwaffe okutuluŋŋamya. Ne Dawudi yassaamu Kabaka Sawulo ekitiibwa, wadde nga Sawulo yamuyisa bubi. Dawudi yategeera nti okussaamu obuyinza ekitiibwa kwe kussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa. Ekitiibwa tekitegeeza buwulize bwa muzibe. Kitegeeza bwetoowaze, bugumiikiriza, n’okwefuga.

Ebyokulabirako mu Bayibuli eby’Obukulembeze

Musa yakulembera ng’ayita mu bugumiikiriza n’okusaba. Teyeeronderamu bukulembeze: Katonda ye yamuyita. Nekkemiya yaddaabiriza bbugwe wa Yerusaalemi wadde nga waaliwo abaamuwakanya, ng’alaga obuvumu n’okukolera awamu. Debora yakulembera Isirayiri n’amagezi n’okukkiriza, ng’alaga nti obukulembeze tebukomekkerezebwa kikula. Yesu yakulembera n’okusaasira, okwewaayo, n’obwesimbu.

Buli mukulembeze Katonda gw’akozesa asooka kuyiga kuweereza mu kasirise nga tannakulembera mu lujjudde.

Amasomo g’Obukulembeze Okuva mu Afirika

Allen Kagina, eyali Commissioner General wa URA, yakakasa nti obwesimbu mu bifo bya ggavumenti busoboka. Obukulembeze bwe obw’emirembe bwazza obuggya mu kitongole ekikulu. Omulabirizi Festo Kivengere yakubiriza abantu enkumi n’enkumi mu kiseera ky’okuzuukuka kw’eddiini mu Uganda ng’abuulira okusonyiwa n’okwagala ne mu kiseera ky’okuyigganyizibwa okunene. Buli omu ku bakulembeze bano yaweereza abantu okusukka ye yennyini.

Obukulembeze obw’Obuweereza mu Bulamu obwa Buli lunaku

Toli mwetaavu kya kitiibwa kya kifo kubeera mukulembeze. Bw’oyamba okuyonja ebibiina, okutegeka ekibiina ky’okuyiga, oba okuzzaamu amaanyi mukwano gwo alwana, obeera oli mukulembeze dda. Obukulembeze obw’obuweereza bwe buyinza obuzimbiddwa ku kyokulabirako, so si ku buyinza. Weebuuze buli lunaku nti: "Ani gwe nnyinza okuweereza leero?" N’okuyamba omuntu omu buli lunaku kukufuula omuntu akyusa ensi mu maaso ga Katonda.

"Mu bwetoowaze buli muntu agulumizenga munne okusinga bwe yeegulumiza yekka. Mubengamu endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo Yesu." — Abafiripi 2:3-5

Okufumiitiriza

  • Oyinza otya okuweereza abalala mu kifo ky’okulindirira okuweerezebwa?
  • Olaga ekitiibwa eky’amazima eri abantu abakwetoolodde?
  • Ani mu bulamu bwo alaga obukulembeze obw’obuweereza gw’oyinza okuyigako?

Okusaba

Mukama, nfuula omukulembeze omuweereza akulembera mu kwagala n’ekyokulabirako. Mpa obwetoowaze okussaamu abalala ekitiibwa, obuvumu okukola ekituufu, n’amaanyi okuweereza n’obwesigwa. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.title: Okuddukanya Ensimbi, Obudde, n’Ebitone
fields.body_html:
"Ate era omuwanika kimugwanira okuba omuntu omwesigwa." — 1 Abakkolinso 4:2

Katonda bw’atunuulira Obuwanika

Omuwanika muntu addukanya ebintu ebya munne. Buli kye tulina, omuli obudde, ensimbi, amagezi, obulamu, n’ebitone, bya Katonda. Abitukwasa tubikozese n’amagezi olw’ekitiibwa kye.

"Ensi ya Mukama n’ebigirimu byonna." — Zabbuli 24:1

Okuddukanya Obudde n’Amagezi

Obudde bwa muwendo okusinga zaabu. Buli lunaku luli ng’ekintu Katonda ky’akuwadde. Engeri gy’obumalamu ye salawo ku bulamu bwo obw’omu maaso. Bw’oyonoona obudde, oyonoona n’emikisa.

Yisaamu empisa ennungi ez’okukolebwa, gamba ng’okugolokoka mu makya n’otandika n’okusaba, okukozesa akatabo oba enteekateeka y’obudde, okwekebejja ebiruubirirwa byo buli wiiki, okwewala okulwisa emirimu n’okukozesa essimu awatali nsonga, n’okuwummula obulungi. Katonda yateekawo okuwummula okuzza obuggya amaanyi.

"Buli kintu kirina ekiseera kyakyo." — Omubuulizi 3:1

Okuddukanya Ensimbi

N’ensimbi entono ez’omu ngalo kigezo ky’obuwanika. Yiga okugabanyaamu ebyo by’ofuna ebitundu bisatu. Waayo ekitundu olw’omulimu gwa Katonda oba olw’okuyamba abalala. Terekako ekitundu, kubanga n’obutereke obutono bweyongera ne budda mu maaso. N’osasule n’amagezi ku ebyo by’oyetaaga ddala, so si ku ebyo ebigenda okwewuunyisa abalala bokka.

"Mu nnyumba y’omutuukirivu mubaamu eby’obugagga eby’omuwendo, naye omusirusiru ebibye byonna abyonoona." — Engero 21:20

Yewale obuggya n’amabanja. Bw’oyiga okuddukanya n’obwesigwa ekitono ky’olina kaakano, Katonda ayinza okukukwasa ebisingawo.

Okuddukanya Ebitone

fields.body_html:
"Omuvubuka anaakuumanga atya ekkubo lye nga ttereevu? Anaalikuumanga ng’agoberera ekigambo kyo nga bwe kiri." — Zabbuli 119:9

Obulongoofu mu Nsi Eyoonoonese

Empisa ez’ennaku zino zitera okuwagira ekibi, naye Katonda ayita abaana be okuba abatukuvu. Obulongoofu si kya dda; bwe buyinza obw’amaanyi obukuuma omutima gwo n’ebiseera byo eby’omu maaso. Obulongoofu buli mu birowoozo byo, mu bigambo byo, mu bikolwa byo, ne mu bigendererwa byo.

"Kubanga Katonda ayagala mutukuzibwe, era mwewalenga obwenzi, buli omu ku mmwe amanyenga okufuga omubiri gwe mu butukuvu n’ekitiibwa." — 1 Basessaloniika 4:3-4

Obulongoofu bw’Omutima

Ekibi kisookera mu mutima nga tekinnafuuka kikolwa. Okukuuma obulongoofu bwo kitegeeza okwekebejja ky’oliisa ebirowoozo byo, omuli firimu z’otunuulira, ennyimba z’owuliriza, ebisaawe by’oyogera, n’ebintu by’otunuulira ku mikutu gy’empuliziganya. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu alongoose okwegomba kwo, ebirowoozo byo bituukanire n’amazima ga Katonda.

"Balina omukisa abalina omutima omulongoofu, kubanga abo baliraba Katonda." — Matayo 5:8

Enkolagana Esanyusa Katonda

Enkolagana ennungi essaamu Katonda ekitiibwa era n’essa ekitiibwa mu nsalo entuufu. Okwagala tekwenkanankana n’okwegomba okubi. Okwagala kugaba; okwegomba okubi kwo kunyaga. Omukwano ogw’amazima gukusembeza kumpi ne Yesu era ne guguma ebiseera byo eby’omu maaso. Enkolagana bw’eba ekuggya ku kusaba, ku bisomo byo, oba ku mirembe gyo, teva eri Katonda.

Okugumiikiriza mu buvubuka bwo kuleeta essanyu mu bukulu bwo.

Engeri y’Okusigala Omulongoofu

Saba buli lunaku amaanyi. Yewale embeera eziyinza okwonoona empisa zo. Jjuza omutima gwo n’Ekyawandiikibwa. Yatulira Katonda okukemebwa amangu nga tekunnakuwamba. Zimba emikwano egigumya obutukuvu. Era ojjukire omuwendo gwo: oli Yeekaalu ya Katonda.

"Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa?" — 1 Abakkolinso 6:19

Ekyokulabirako: Obujulizi bwa Ruth

Ruth ow’e Mukono yasalawo okusigala omulongoofu mu by’omubiri newaakubadde ng’emikwano gye gyamuwaliriza nnyo. Emikwano gye gyamusekerera, nga bagamba nti wa dda. Nga wayiseewo emyaka, Katonda yassaamu ekitiibwa okusalawo kwe. Yamaliriza n’okuba ku ntikko mu kibinja kye, yafumbirwa omusajja atya Katonda, era n’afuuka omulagirizi w’abavubuka. Kaakano agamba abayizi nti: "Obulongoofu bukuuma emirembe gyo."

Okufumiitiriza

  • Mpisa ki oba nkolagana ki eziyinza okwonoona obulongoofu bwo?
  • Oyinza otya okunyweza enkolagana yo ne Katonda mu kitundu kino?
  • Ani gw’oyinza okwogerako mu bwesimbu ku kitundu kino eky’obulamu bwo?

Okusaba

Mukama, nnyamba nsigale omulongoofu mu mutima, mu birowoozo, ne mu mubiri. Mpa amaanyi okuziyiza okukemebwa n’obuvumu okubeera ow’enjawulo. Njjuza Omwoyo wo buli lunaku. Amiina.

fields.title: Okusuubira Ebiseera eby’Omu Maaso
fields.body_html:
"Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi." — Kaabakuuku 2:2

Okubeera n’Ekigendererwa

Okusuubira kuwa amakulu ku kufuba kwa leero. Awatali kwo, otenderera n’oyonoona obusobozi bwo. Okusuubira Katonda kw’alina ku bulamu bwo kwawandiikibwa nga tonnazaalibwa (Yeremiya 1:5). Amanyi ebitone byo, bye weegomba, n’okuyitibwa kwo. Omulimu gwo kwe kumunoonya n’okutambulira mu nteekateeka gy’akutegekedde.

Engeri y’Okuzuula Okusuubira kwa Katonda

Saba era owulirize. Katonda ayogera ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye ne mu mirembe gy’assa mu mutima gwo. Kebera ebirabo byo n’ebyo by’owuliriramu ennyo, kubanga ky’oyagala okukola kitera okukwatagana n’okuyitibwa kwo. Ssaayo omwoyo ku ekyo ekikuluma ku mutima. Nsonga ki gy’oyagala okugonjoola? Okwegomba okwo kuyinza okulaga ekigendererwa kyo. Era noonya okubuulirirwa okuva mu Bakristaayo abakuze abayinza okukakasa okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda.

"Enteekateeka z’omuntu ziba nnyingi mu mutima gwe; byo ebigendererwa bya Mukama bituukirira." — Engero 19:21

Abaloosi ab’omu Bayibuli

Yusufu yaloota obukulembeze n’agumiikiriza ebigezo bingi ng’ekirooto ekyo tekinnatuukirira. Eseza yakozesa ekifo kye n’obuvumu bwe okununula abantu be. Nekkemiya yalaba bbugwe eyali agudde n’amuzimba buggya newaakubadde ng’awakanyizibwa. Pawulo yaloota okubuulira Enjiri mu nsi yonna gye baali bamanyi, era n’akikola. Buli kirooto kyatandika kitono naye ne kikula ng’ekiyita mu kukkiriza n’okugumiikiriza.

Ebiziyiza Okusuubira

Okutya, ekibi, obugayaavu, n’okuggwaamu essuubi biyinza okubikka ku kusuubira kwo. Ebirooto ebimu bifa kubanga abantu balekera awo okubikkiririzaamu. Ebirala biremererwa olw’amalala oba obutagumiikiriza. Kuuma amaaso go ku Yesu. Ajja kukulaga ekiseera ekituufu n’ekkubo ettuufu.

Ebyokulabirako eby’Omulembe Guno

Martin Luther King Jr. yaloota obwenkanya wakati w’amawanga obufuniddwa mu mirembe, so si mu bukambwe, era n’akinoonya n’obwesigwa. Stephen Kiprotich yalengera zaabu ya Olympic mu biseera by’okwetendeka okuwanvu, okw’obwerere, ku nsozi za Uganda. Ben Carson yaloota okufuuka omusawo alonga ng’akulira mu bwavu, era n’akikola, ng’ayita mu kukkiriza n’okufuba okutakoowa. Katonda atera okusiga ebirooto ebisinga obunene mu mitima egisinga okwetoowaza.

Okuzimba Ebiseera eby’Omu Maaso Kaddekkadde

Sigala okumpi ne Katonda buli lunaku. Soma n’obunyiikivu. Kuza empisa zo mu buli kye osalawo. Terekako ensimbi entono obutayosa era teekateeka ng’otunuulira ewala. Noonya abalagirizi abayinza okukuluŋŋamya n’okukugumya. Weereza abalala n’obwesigwa, kubanga Katonda akuza abaweereza.

"Tuli mulimu gwa Katonda, abaatondebwa mu Kristo Yesu, okukolanga ebikolwa ebirungi." — Abaefeso 2:10

Okufumiitiriza

  • Kirooto ki Katonda ky’atadde mu mutima gwo?
  • Kambe ki akatono k’oyinza okutambula leero okusembera awo?
  • Ani ayinza okuba omulagirizi okukuluŋŋamya mu biseera byo eby’omu maaso?

Okusaba

Mukama, mpa okusuubira n’amagezi ku biseera byange eby’omu maaso. Nnyamba nootole ebinene, nkole n’amaanyi, era nsigale nga ndi mwesigwa. Luŋŋamya amakubo gange obulamu bwange bulyoke bugulumize ggwe. Amiina.

fields.title: Genda mu Maaso: Empisa Kkumi na Bbiri ez’Obulamu
fields.body_html:
Otuuse ku nkomerero y’ekitabo kino, naye olugendo olw’amazima lutandika kaakano. Amagezi tegafunibwa lwa kusoma mulundi gumu. Gakula ng’obeera bye wayiga buli lunaku. Oyimiridde ku mulyango gw’ebiseera byo eby’omu maaso. Buli kye osalawo, engeri gy’osomamu, gy’osabamu, gy’oyogeramu, ne gy’oyisaamu abalala, kizimba omuntu gw’ofuuka.

Wammanga waliwo empisa kkumi na bbiri ez’obulamu ezijja okukuyamba okugenda mu maaso n’obwesige n’obukulu mu Kristo.

1. Tandika Buli Lunaku ne Katonda

Tandika enkya zo n’okusaba n’Ekyawandiikibwa, ne bw’eba edakiika ttaano zokka. Yita Katonda aluŋŋamye olunaku lwo nga tewannaba muntu yenna kulwogerako. Bw’ozuukuka, weere mu ddoboozi eppangavu nti: "Mukama, olunaku luno lwuwo."

"Ayi Mukama, buli nkya owulira eddoboozi lyange; buli nkya ndeeta gy’oli okusaba kwange, ne nnindirira onziremu." — Zabbuli 5:3

2. Beera Munywevu mu Kusaba

Okusaba si mulimu gwa buvunaanyizibwa. Bwe bwa mukwano. Yogera ne Katonda ku by’otya, ku birooto byo, ne ku bisomo byo. Sabira banno mu kibinja, abasomesa bo, n’ab’omu maka go. Kuuma akatabo akatono ak’okusaba era owandiikemu by’osaba. Ng’ekiseera kigenda, ojja kulaba obwesigwa bwa Katonda nga buwandiikiddwa okubuna obulamu bwo bwonna.

3. Zimba Empisa y’Okusoma Ekigambo kya Katonda

Ekigambo kya Katonda kijja kukuyigiriza, kikutereeze, era kikuluŋŋamye. Tandikira ku Ngero olw’amagezi ne ku Zabbuli olw’okugumibwa. Soma katono buli lunaku. N’olunyiriri lumu luyinza okuliisa emmeeme yo. Tekawo akabonero ku nnyiriri ezikwogera ku mutima era ozijjukire. Leka Ekyawandiikibwa kifuuke munno gwe muyita nabo buli lunaku.

"Ekigambo kyo ye ttaala eri ebigere byange, era kye kimulisa ekkubo lyange." — Zabbuli 119:105

4. Teekawo Ebiruubirirwa Ebitegeerekeka

fields.title: Ebyawandiikibwa Ekkumi Ebikulu eri Abayizi
fields.body_html:
Soma, Kwata mu Mutwe, era Obeere Ennyiriri Zino

Wammanga waliwo ennyiriri kkumi ez’amaanyi ez’okumanya, okukwata mu mutwe, n’okubeera. Ku buli lumu, ojja kusanga okufumiitiriza okumpi, okusaba, n’engeri ennungamu gy’oyinza okulukozesa mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku.

1. Engero 3:5-6

"Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula." — Engero 3:5-6

Okufumiitiriza: Obulamu bwe buba tebukakafu, weesige Katonda, so si ku nneewulira zo oba ku ndowooza za banno. Alaba enkya bulungi okusinga ggwe bw’olaba olwa leero.

Okusaba: Mukama, nnonze okukwesiga mu bisomo byange, mu ebyo bye nsalawo, ne mu biseera byange eby’omu maaso. Njigiriza okuwuliriza okuluŋŋamya kwo.

Enkozesa: Nga tonnasalawo kintu kyonna, ka kibe ku ssomo ly’osoma, ku mukwano, oba ku kkubo ly’omulimu, yimirira osabe. Leka Katonda akulembere.

2. Abafiripi 4:13

"Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi." — Abafiripi 4:13

Okufumiitiriza: Amaanyi go gokka gayinza okukulemererwa, naye amaanyi ga Kristo tegaggwaawo. Obuwanguzi busoboka Katonda bw’awa amaanyi okufuba kwo.

Okusaba: Yesu, mpa amaanyi okusoma, okweyongerayo, n’okuwangula okutya. Nzijukize nti nnyinza okukola byonna nga oli ku ludda lwange.

Enkozesa: Nga tonnaba kukola bibuuzo oba okuyita mu bizibu, yogera olunyiriri luno mu ddoboozi eppangavu ng’olangirira okukkiriza kwo.

3. Yeremiya 29:11

"Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli, enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso, bw’ayogera Mukama." — Yeremiya 29:11

Okufumiitiriza: Obulamu bwo tebwa kubaawo buwaawo. Katonda alina enteekateeka enkalamba era ey’okwagala ku lulwo. Ne bw’oba tosobola kugiraba, akolera mu kyama.

Okusaba: Kitange, nkwebaza kubanga olina enteekateeka ku lwange. Nnyamba ntambulire mu kigendererwa kyo n’okukkiriza n’okugumiikiriza.

Enkozesa: Wandiika olunyiriri luno mu maaso g’akatabo ko. Lusome bw’owulira ng’obuze oba ng’oggwaamu essuubi.

4. Matayo 6:33

"Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako." — Matayo 6:33

Okufumiitiriza: Bw’oteeka Katonda mu maaso mu mutima gwo, mu bisomo byo, ne mu nkolagana zo, ategeka ebirala byonna mu ntegeka.

Okusaba: Mukama, nnyamba nkwagale okusinga obuwanguzi, okwatiikirira, oba obugagga. Ebyo by’osooka bifuuke bye nsooka nange.

Enkozesa: Wa Katonda ebiseera ebisooka ebya buli lunaku n’ekifo ekisooka mu buli ky’osalawo.

5. Yoswa 1:8

"Ekitabo kino eky’amateeka tekikuvanga mu kamwa, okifumiitirizangako emisana n’ekiro olyoke oteekenga mu nkola ebyo bye kikulagira era bw’otyo bw’oneefunira obuwanguzi n’okukulaakulana." — Yoswa 1:8

Okufumiitiriza: Obuwanguzi obw’amazima buva mu buwulize n’okufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Bayibuli ye muluŋŋamya asinga ku bulamu obw’obuwanguzi.

Okusaba: Ggwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, mpa enjala ey’Ekigambo kyo. Leka amazima go gakole ebirowoozo byange n’ebyo bye nsalawo.

Enkozesa: Kwata mu mutwe waakiri ennyiriri bbiri buli wiiki era ozigabane ne munno.

6. Engero 1:7

"Kale mu kutya Mukama amagezi mwe gasookera, naye abasirusiru banyooma amagezi n’okulagirirwa." — Engero 1:7

Okufumiitiriza: Okussa Katonda ekitiibwa kwe ntandikwa y’okuyigirizibwa okw’amazima. Amagezi ag’amazima tegasangibwa mu bitabo byokka, wabula ne mu mpisa ne mu kutya Katonda.

Okusaba: Mukama, nfuula omuyizi assaamu amagezi ekitiibwa, so si obuwanguzi bwa maaka bwokka. Nnyamba nkkirize okunenyezebwa n’obwetoowaze.

Enkozesa: Abasomesa bwe bakuwa amagezi, gakkirize awatali busungu. Okunenyezebwa kulongoosa amagezi.

7. Abakkolosaayi 3:23

"Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu." — Abakkolosaayi 3:23

Okufumiitiriza: Okusoma n’okukola bikolwa bya kusinza bwe bikolebwa n’omutima gwonna. Okufuba kwo kussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa ne bw’abalala baba tebakiraba.

Okusaba: Kitange, nnyamba mpeeyo ekisinga obulungi mu buli mulimu, nga mmanyi nti olaba buli kantu.

Enkozesa: Ka obe oyonja, oddamu okusoma ebiwandiiko byo, oba oyamba awaka, kikole n’essanyu ng’okolera Katonda butereevu.

8. Zabbuli 119:9

"Omuvubuka anaakuumanga atya ekkubo lye nga ttereevu? Anaalikuumanga ng’agoberera ekigambo kyo nga bwe kiri." — Zabbuli 119:9

Okufumiitiriza: Obulongoofu bukuuma ekigendererwa kyo. Ekigambo kya Katonda kikuuma omutima gwo eri obwonoonefu n’okwejjusa.

Okusaba: Mukama, longoosa omutima gwange era onnuŋŋamye n’Ekigambo kyo. Onkuume ku buli kintu ekyandikuggyeko ekitiibwa.

Enkozesa: Londa emikwano, ebijjula amawulire, n’empisa eza buli lunaku ebigumya obulongoofu bwo mu kifo ky’okubunafuya.

9. Abaruumi 12:2

"So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe." — Abaruumi 12:2

Okufumiitiriza: Empisa z’ensi zikyukakyuka buli kiseera, naye amazima ga Katonda tegakaddiwa. Leka Ekigambo kye kizze obuggya ebirowoozo byo, endowooza yo, n’ebirooto byo.

Okusaba: Yesu, nnyamba nziyize ebintu ebibi ebinnyiga. Kyusa ebirowoozo byange ndyoke nzeewe era nkole nga ggwe.

Enkozesa: Mala ekiseera ekingi mu Kyawandiikibwa okusinga ku mikutu gy’empuliziganya. Waanyisaamu endowooza ey’ensi n’endowooza ekolebwa obwakabaka bwa Katonda.

10. Zabbuli 37:4

"Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga." — Zabbuli 37:4

Okufumiitiriza: Okusanyukira Katonda kitegeeza okufuna essanyu eddene mu maaso ge. Essanyu lyo bwe libeera nga lisimbye emirandira mu ye, bye weegomba bitandika okutuukagana n’okwagala kwe, n’emikisa ne gigoberera awatali kufuba.

Okusaba: Mukama, ffuuka essanyu lyange erisingayo. Kola bye neegomba bulyoke bulage omutima gwo.

Enkozesa: Tenderezanga Katonda emirundi mingi, ne ku mikisa emitono. Essanyu n’okwebaza bisikiriza ekisa kye.

Ng’okwata mu mutwe era ng’obeera Ebyawandiikibwa bino, jjukira: si bigambo bya ddogo. Ge mazima amalamu agakyusa emitima. Bikuume mu birowoozo byo, obiwandiike mu mutima gwo, era obileke bikole by’osalawo. Ekigambo kya Katonda si kya kusoma kyokka. Kya kubeera.

"Ntadde ekigambo kyo mu mutima gwange; ndyoke nneme okwonoona." — Zabbuli 119:11

Okusaba: Mukama, nnyamba nkwagale okusinga obuwanguzi, okwatiikirira, oba obugagga. Ebyo by’osooka bifuuke bye nsooka nange. Enkozesa: Wa Katonda ebiseera ebisooka ebya buli lunaku n’ekifo ekisooka mu buli ky’osalawo. 5. Yoswa 1:8 "Ekitabo kino eky’amateeka tekikuvanga mu kamwa, okifumiitirizangako emisana n’ekiro olyoke oteekenga mu nkola ebyo bye kikulagira era bw’otyo bw’oneefunira obuwanguzi n’okukulaakulana." — Yoswa 1:8 Okufumiitiriza: Obuwanguzi obw’amazima buva mu buwulize n’okufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Bayibuli ye muluŋŋamya asinga ku bulamu obw’obuwanguzi. Okusaba: Ggwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, mpa enjala ey’Ekigambo kyo. Leka amazima go gakole ebirowoozo byange n’ebyo bye nsalawo. Enkozesa: Kwata mu mutwe waakiri ennyiriri bbiri buli wiiki era ozigabane ne munno. 6. Engero 1:7 "Kale mu kutya Mukama amagezi mwe gasookera, naye abasirusiru banyooma amagezi n’okulagirirwa." — Engero 1:7 Okufumiitiriza: Okussa Katonda ekitiibwa kwe ntandikwa y’okuyigirizibwa okw’amazima. Amagezi ag’amazima tegasangibwa mu bitabo byokka, wabula ne mu mpisa ne mu kutya Katonda. Okusaba: Mukama, nfuula omuyizi assaamu amagezi ekitiibwa, so si obuwanguzi bwa maaka bwokka. Nnyamba nkkirize okunenyezebwa n’obwetoowaze. Enkozesa: Abasomesa bwe bakuwa amagezi, gakkirize awatali busungu. Okunenyezebwa kulongoosa amagezi. 7. Abakkolosaayi 3:23 "Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu." — Abakkolosaayi 3:23 Okufumiitiriza: Okusoma n’okukola bikolwa bya kusinza bwe bikolebwa n’omutima gwonna. Okufuba kwo kussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa ne bw’abalala baba tebakiraba. Okusaba: Kitange, nnyamba mpeeyo ekisinga obulungi mu buli mulimu, nga mmanyi nti olaba buli kantu. Enkozesa: Ka obe oyonja, oddamu okusoma ebiwandiiko byo, oba oyamba awaka, kikole n’essanyu ng’okolera Katonda butereevu. 8. Zabbuli 119:9 "Omuvubuka anaakuumanga atya ekkubo lye nga ttereevu? Anaalikuumanga ng’agoberera ekigambo kyo nga bwe kiri." — Zabbuli 119:9 Okufumiitiriza: Obulongoofu bukuuma ekigendererwa kyo. Ekigambo kya Katonda kikuuma omutima gwo eri obwonoonefu n’okwejjusa. Okusaba: Mukama, longoosa omutima gwange era onnuŋŋamye n’Ekigambo kyo. Onkuume ku buli kintu ekyandikuggyeko ekitiibwa. Enkozesa: Londa emikwano, ebijjula amawulire, n’empisa eza buli lunaku ebigumya obulongoofu bwo mu kifo ky’okubunafuya. 9. Abaruumi 12:2 "So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe." — Abaruumi 12:2 Okufumiitiriza: Empisa z’ensi zikyukakyuka buli kiseera, naye amazima ga Katonda tegakaddiwa. Leka Ekigambo kye kizze obuggya ebirowoozo byo, endowooza yo, n’ebirooto byo. Okusaba: Yesu, nnyamba nziyize ebintu ebibi ebinnyiga. Kyusa ebirowoozo byange ndyoke nzeewe era nkole nga ggwe. Enkozesa: Mala ekiseera ekingi mu Kyawandiikibwa okusinga ku mikutu gy’empuliziganya. Waanyisaamu endowooza ey’ensi n’endowooza ekolebwa obwakabaka bwa Katonda. 10. Zabbuli 37:4 "Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga." — Zabbuli 37:4 Okufumiitiriza: Okusanyukira Katonda kitegeeza okufuna essanyu eddene mu maaso ge. Essanyu lyo bwe libeera nga lisimbye emirandira mu ye, bye weegomba bitandika okutuukagana n’okwagala kwe, n’emikisa ne gigoberera awatali kufuba. Okusaba: Mukama, ffuuka essanyu lyange erisingayo. Kola bye neegomba bulyoke bulage omutima gwo. Enkozesa: Tenderezanga Katonda emirundi mingi, ne ku mikisa emitono. Essanyu n’okwebaza bisikiriza ekisa kye. Ng’okwata mu mutwe era ng’obeera Ebyawandiikibwa bino, jjukira: si bigambo bya ddogo. Ge mazima amalamu agakyusa emitima. Bikuume mu birowoozo byo, obiwandiike mu mutima gwo, era obileke bikole by’osalawo. Ekigambo kya Katonda si kya kusoma kyokka. Kya kubeera. "Ntadde ekigambo kyo mu mutima gwange; ndyoke nneme okwonoona." — Zabbuli 119:11
